lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularized grid of high-intensity circular local maxima organized into at least four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with relatively uniform spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical luminance gradients intersecting with horizontal blob rows, forming a structural grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the dorsal-lateral flank characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow pixel gradient oriented vertically.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast, slender ichthyic silhouettes (remoras) are visible trailing the ventral-pectoral region.
